name: A Hero's path stat grants grow on level-up without a relog
contract: Path of Strength 84864 grants Path of Strength: Stat Buff 820043, whose effect 1 is 4 + level / 2 Strength; Path of Agility 84865 links 954688, whose effect 1 is level ranged attack power. Per-level amounts are fixed when an aura is applied, so before the realm's level-up fix a path picked at 10 kept its level-10 grant until a relog. After the fix a level-up recalculates the player's own passive auras: from 10 to 20 the Strength grant goes from 9 to 14 and the ranged attack power from 10 to 20.

steps.label: Path of Strength applies its Stat Buff
Path of Agility links its ranged attack power
At 10 the ranged attack power grant is 10
At 20 without a relog the Strength grant is 14
and the ranged attack power grant is 20
